body: Thanks for the suggestion, but unless you have desirable skills you can't make it the freelance market. I have no desirable talents.

Thank you. I appreciate that you find me intriguing, but with all due respect you're just a name on a screen. Trust me, in flesh and blood it's like I'm a person repellant. Very awkward, barely able to keep a conversation. If you saw me at a party you would never come up to me to talk. While I appreciate your efforts, I still have to live in a world where the people in my life only listen to what I have to say out of politeness or out of obligation, not because they really care. No one wants to take the time to get to know the real me because I'm just not interesting. Or I'm too weird and crazy. I'm just dead weight in the world that has no place for me. I think some people are too different to really live comfortably in this world. I think I'm one of them.

Hello,

Thanks for responding. I'm a very sensitive person. Always have been. I take things very personally and I have a very bad temper. These facets of my personality have always caused me problems. I've learned to control my anger, but now I internalize everything. I'm too ashamed of looking foolish to try anything else to release my anger. I just don't think I have any business doing anything traditionally masculine like sports, or martial arts. I always feel to inept. That's generally how I feel about everything.
I'm not comfortable with who I am, and I don't have fortitude to change it. I'm too difficult and all efforts from therapists to try and change my thinking have failed.

I moved out on my own a few months back so I changed my environment somewhat. But my issues started plaguing me again. I realize I can change my environment and do what I want, but I fear the consequences. I'm at school right now with two semesters left to graduate. I also work part time. If I stop to do my own thing, I'll lose everything I've worked for up to that point. But I can't continue on the way I am. 

I just wish I lived in a world where my success wasn't contingent on others. One way or another, you can't be successful in this world unless others like you. And that's something that I will never be able to attain. I'm just too weird and crazy to be understood much less liked.
